column1: Legend: Target columns = planned load (kg). Blue 'Actual' columns = you fill in. Example: Incline DB press M1 actual -> 12.5. DB = per hand; barbell/EZ-bar = total incl. bar (20 kg / ~8 kg EZ). Pull-up: negative = assist, positive = added.
Rules: +2.5 kg after hitting top of rep range on all sets; drop 2.5 kg after missing rep floor twice; deload wks 8/16/24 (same weight, 40% fewer sets). M1-M2 Stage 1, M3-M4 Stage 2, M5-M6 Stage 3.
